name: Pecker PI
source:
While a war rages in a foreign country, the mob rule the streets of Rackham City. Your journey starts shortly after you return from serving your country in the jungles of southeast Asia. The war has interrupted your promising boxing career. Due to an injury sustained during combat, the dream of becoming a world championship boxer is crushed. Helped by your best friend, you reluctantly become a private investigator. During your first routine infidelity case, you accidentally stumble into something much bigger:
The Curse of the Pearl Necklace
